parsed_output.embedding_text: Artist Cody Sabol (@codysabolart) performs a speed painting challenge on stage, completing a detailed portrait of Andrew Garfield's Spider-Man in just 7 minutes. The video shows the creative process from a blank black canvas to a finished, vibrant painting featuring bold red, white, and blue accents. Set to the 'Spider-Man Theme - Epic Version' from the No Way Home trailer, the performance is a high-speed art demonstration. On-screen text reads 'Painting Andrew Garfield Spider-Man in 7 minutes!!'. The artist is seen wearing a green jacket and paint-splattered pants while working on a large easel in front of blue stage curtains. This content is ideal for fans of Marvel, Spider-Man, and speed painting techniques looking for artistic inspiration or entertainment.
